name: Dennis Smelt
bio: a Representative from Georgia; born in Essex County, Va., on November 23, 1763; received a limited schooling; served in the Revolutionary War; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Ninth Congress to fill the vacancy caused by the resignation of United States Representative Joseph Bryan; reelected to the Tenth and Eleventh Congresses (September 1, 1806-March 3, 1811); was not a candidate for reelection to the Twelfth Congress; died in 1818.
